Close-out 2026-11-19T07:19Z: PR #35361 MERGED as `35c6331094`; `Fixes` closed this card. Delivered: a seed row whose key reference was still empty when it landed is now recorded in the landed-key ledger under the id derived from its AUTHORED key (the id it lands with, #34800), so a person's delete of it sticks on later loads, both while the reference stays empty and after the person signs up; a deliberate re-seed still restores it, and complete-key rows are unchanged. A withdrawn deferred row also drops its pass-2 deferrals, so pass 2 reports no false drop. Out of scope: none filed. Same-file follow-ons now unblocked: #34857 + #35336 (ruled B1) with p3 #35376 riding. `pm:dispatched` off.
